about.title: What is Unseen Bangladesh?
about.body1: Unseen Bangladesh is a free guide to all 64 districts. Next to the famous beaches and hills it highlights lesser-known places, like a haor in the monsoon, an old mosque or a tea garden at dawn, with the best months, how to get there and what it costs.
about.body2: It works in Bengali and English, needs no account and never tracks you.

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.a1: Yes. There are no fees, no ads and no paywall. Everything here, including the planner, maps and games, is free to use.
faq.a2: No. There are no ad networks or tracking scripts, and the fonts and images are hosted by us. We only count visits per day, with no personal details. The districts you tick stay in your own browser unless you choose to make an account.
faq.a3: All 64 districts, 257 places (130 well known and 127 lesser known), 150 route pages and 120 intercity train timetables.
faq.q4: How current are the fares and train times?
faq.a4: Each fare and timetable shows the date it was checked and how confident we are, with links to the sources. Fares change often, so confirm at the counter or on the official e-ticket site before you travel.
faq.a5: No. You can explore, plan trips, tick districts and send photos without one. An account only adds saved trips, your profile and syncing between devices.
faq.q6: Can I add my own photos, places or business?
faq.a6: Yes. Send a photo, suggest a place or a food from your area, or list your business. A person reads every submission before it appears on the site.
